the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

program = '''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    divider = max(c for row in grid for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != 0)
    for r, row in enumerate(grid):
        c = divider - 1
        while c >= 0 and row[c] == 0:
            c -= 1
        if c < 0:
            continue
        color = row[c]
        run = 0
        while c >= 0 and row[c] == color:
            run += 1
            c -= 1
        for j in range(divider + 1, len(row), run):
            out[r][j] = color
    return out
'''
py_path.write_text(program)
ns={}; exec(program,ns)
